Name: European Coastal Airlines
Company description: European Coastal Airlines is a seaplane operator based in Kaštel Štafilić, Croatia and founded in the year 2000. Ever since it is working on the infrastructural project to start regular seaplane operations to connect major cities and islands along the croatian coast with each other. The project was recognized and is supported by various key figures of the European Union, such as namely the german chancellor Angela Merkel, as well as by the AdriSeaplanes project - a project which is co-funded by the European Union and the IPA - Adriatic Cross-Border Cooperation Program.  The goal is to connect all 66 inhabited islands of Croatia as well as at a later stage expand operations to Italy, Monaco and Greece. The project is a multi-million euro investment and will create around 400 new jobs in the Republic of Croatia. European Coastal Airlines is committed to maintain a high standard of business ethics, honesty and integrity in line with eco-friendliness and hence ensure social, ethical and environmental responsibility.

Name: Adventure Driven Vacations
Company description: Adventure Driven Vacations (ADV) is the first Specialised Operation (SPO) for tandem skydiving in Croatia, certified by the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA). We’ll guide you into the exciting world of skydiving with passion, safety, and unforgettable scenery. This unique location sits between two stunning national parks—Paklenica and Kornati. Or choose to jump over the majestic forests of the Lika region, near Otocac and the famous Plitvice Lakes National Park. Experience the thrill of skydiving above the sea during one of the world’s most beautiful sunsets in Zadar—and land right on the beach. You’ll be in the hands of highly experienced skydiving professionals and pilots, using meticulously maintained gear and our own turbine aircraft built specifically for skydiving. It’s our passion—and our greatest reward—to make every jump a memory for life. Our mission is simple: to put a big smile on your face and safely share the freedom, adrenaline, and beauty of this incredible sport. At ADV, we don’t just offer tandem skydiving in Croatia—we craft life-changing experiences. Come for the thrill, leave transformed!
